title: AtMem host task lifecycle request
description: A host request to change a task's lifecycle. It is a request, never a command: existing lifecycle and completion gates decide it and are never bypassed. Cancellation is absent by design -- it is operator-only under the Governance Matrix. Carries no actor_role, capability or authority field by construction. Actor role is derived from the authenticated transport and the registered adapter identity; a submission carrying one is malformed rather than honoured or silently ignored.

task_id.description: Checked against the task the session resolves to; a redundant assertion, never the authority.

identity.description: All three parts are required together. Hosts declare these fields as optional, so a partial identity is one AtMem cannot place; resolving on whatever survived would be guessing, and guessing is what the binding exists to prevent.
